workedExamples.question: The cuboid $ABCDEFGH$ has $AB = 8$ cm, $BC = 6$ cm and $CG = 5$ cm. Find (a) the length $AG$, (b) the angle between $AG$ and the base $ABCD$. Give answers to 3 significant figures.
workedExamples.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 290" width="360" height="290"><path d="M40 250 L240 250 L300 200 L300 100 L100 100 L40 150 Z" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="40" y1="150" x2="240" y2="150" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="240" y1="150" x2="240" y2="250" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="240" y1="150" x2="300" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="100" y2="200" stroke="currentColor" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="100" y1="200" x2="300" y2="200" stroke="currentColor" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="100" y1="200" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="currentColor" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="300" y2="200" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="40" y1="250" x2="300" y2="100" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2"/><text x="26" y="266" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">A</text><text x="236" y="268" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">B</text><text x="306" y="212" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">C</text><text x="86" y="196" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">D</text><text x="24" y="148" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">E</text><text x="246" y="168" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">F</text><text x="306" y="98" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">G</text><text x="92" y="94" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">H</text><text x="124" y="270" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">8 cm</text><text x="276" y="242" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">6 cm</text><text x="306" y="155" fill="currentColor" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif">5 cm</text></svg>
workedExamples.solution:
**(a)** Triangle $ABC$ (in the base, right angle at $B$):
$$AC = \sqrt{8^2 + 6^2} = \sqrt{100} = 10 \text{ cm}$$

Triangle $ACG$ (vertical, right angle at $C$):
$$AG = \sqrt{10^2 + 5^2} = \sqrt{125} = 11.18\ldots \approx 11.2 \text{ cm}$$

**(b)** $G$ is directly above $C$, so the projection of $AG$ onto the base is $AC$. The angle is $\angle GAC$:
$$\tan \angle GAC = \frac{CG}{AC} = \frac{5}{10}$$

$$\angle GAC = \tan^{-1}(0.5) = 26.56\ldots^\circ \approx 26.6^\circ$$

workedExamples.question: A pyramid has a square base of side 6 cm. The apex is vertically above the centre of the base and each sloping edge is 7 cm. Find (a) the exact height of the pyramid, (b) the angle between a sloping edge and the base, to 1 decimal place.
workedExamples.solution:
**(a)** Base diagonal $= \sqrt{6^2 + 6^2} = \sqrt{72} = 6\sqrt{2}$, so half-diagonal $= 3\sqrt{2}$ cm.

The height, the half-diagonal and a sloping edge form a right-angled triangle (right angle at the centre of the base):
$$h^2 = 7^2 - (3\sqrt{2})^2 = 49 - 18 = 31$$

$$h = \sqrt{31} \text{ cm} \ (\approx 5.57 \text{ cm})$$

**(b)** The projection of the sloping edge onto the base is the half-diagonal, so
$$\cos\theta = \frac{3\sqrt{2}}{7}$$

$$\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{7}\right) = 52.69\ldots^\circ \approx 52.7^\circ$$
